purpose: Walks a sleep or lid-close and the next wake on a running Squire, end to end through the product's real entry points on a target Mac. Takes the target host as a parameter (SQUIRE_TARGET_HOST, an SSH destination, or RCF_TARGET_URL); without one it skips with the line 'external: needs a target host' and never passes.
title: Sleep and wake on a target Mac

testCases.description: On a target Mac: within two minutes of waking from sleep or a closed lid, one registered and connected Squire session runs.
testCases.testPointer: tests/e2e/round-2-session.test.js::after the target sleeps or its lid is closed and it wakes, within two minutes of the wake exactly one Squire session is running, registered and connected
